pieces.text: For example, listen to the word
If you add the sound /d/ to the beginning of rip, you get
If you change the first sound in drip to /t/, the word changes to

contents.text: When two letters come together to make one sound, they are called a digraph.
Some digraphs are sh, th, and ch.
When you spell a word, think about each sound in the word. Then, pick the letter or digraph that matches each sound.
